card.name: Linking words before a tool or means
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as for, with, as, a, or the in a phrase that explains what a tool, aid or means is used for. Often found in descriptions of instruments or ways of seeing, reading or understanding.

modes.label: Instrument descriptions
modes.description: Linking word after an instrument or procedure is named, before its purpose or parts.
modes.example: an instrument with a lighted, cone-shaped end piece<< for>> looking in the ear canal at the e

modes.label: Aids for hearing or sight
modes.description: Linking word in text about subtitles, reading or vision aids and who benefits.
modes.example: include subtitles for the benefit of people<< with>> hearing impairments.

modes.label: Means of understanding
modes.description: Word in a phrase about a way or source of knowing something.
modes.example: the map is essentially a<< window>> back in time
